feature_contract.goal: Restore complete stage-extension +TIME sprite and numeric original native R84 binocular HUD rendering without allowing previous road/world shader c64 to reject fixed-function GPU eye delivery, preserving live phase and end-of-stage results.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original 0x9898E/0x98A36 sprani and 0x989AD/0x98A10/0x98A89 numeric exact StageExtensionTime physical owners in R30/R33; original 0x98AC6 mode=2 animation, GOAL, menu, lens, ordinary HUD, SkyGlow, input/FFB, R26_SAFE, DX11 and DXVK stay untouched.
trace_stages: Canonical original game's two +TIME sprite and three exact numeral E8 callers enter StageExtensionEnter/Leave and queue or direct D3DX ScreenHud ownership with source-generation protection.
D3DX and SpriteNode physical GPU Draw captures exact producer/queue/pose and original shader identity at R30 fixed-function/XYZRHW or R33 HUD; R30 already skips foreign VS c64 when shaderless.

R33 previously required stale game raw c64 even with shader identity zero; updated R33 admits valid shaderless direct and queued +TIME while demanding strict same-shader original generation for shader-backed producers.

Native left post-call and pre-right source fences retain queue epoch, physical Draw serial, shader, pose and original raw c64 generation; game state/RT/depth/viewport and conservative original fallback are unchanged.
subcomponents: R33 shaderless +TIME physical owner now excludes unrelated previous world/GOAL c64 while preserving original shader-backed game c64 matching across left/right.
Shared stage physical Source validity prohibits stale nonzero raw c64 on fixed-function physical glyphs and preserves qualified queued and direct source identity.
C++ smoke tests cover both +TIME source modes, queued sprite and direct numeric, original shader generation changes, wrong producer and right-eye regression while retaining native fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Both original +TIME numeric and sprani physical GPU sources qualify for independent left/right stereo despite an unrelated previous world c64 write; native pose, queue, draw and source remains exact.

A fixed-function stage cannot borrow raw world c64; shader-owned stage rejects mismatched original game shader or raw generation and retains original single-draw conservative fallback without disabling other HUD/effects.

All required DX9Ex Active Windows game/host/package, Domain Isolation, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact GitHub Actions complete SUCCESS at the final validation-bearing exact SHA; Quest3 runtime separately UNTESTED.

diagnosis.original_evidence: 2026-10-19 canonical original E8 StageExtensionSpraniCalls and StageExtensionPrintCalls and current R84 R30/R33 source captures; 0x98AC6 mode=2 remains excluded as documented by SHA-pinned original REA.
diagnosis.root_cause: R30CaptureStagePhysicalSource skips the last original game c64 when no current vertex shader, while R33 captureStageSource still unconditionally fetches it and rejects foreign world raw shader during shaderless stage rendering.
source_trace: Original StageExtensionEnter establishes source-backed direct owner or deferred SpriteNode tags, before StageExtensionLeave flushes exact owned D3DX batches.
R30 physical fixed-function/XYZRHW captures raw c64 only when RequiresOriginalShaderC64(shader) while R33 previously always checked foreign raw game c64 regardless of shader.
New R33 branch and shared Source admission match the R30 physical owner rule, and unchanged post-left/pre-right transactions enforce same source and eye state.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Static first-eye and second-eye source admission is repaired for shaderless +TIME, with exact generation protection for shader route. No matching Quest3/VDXR live GPU/HMD proof yet.
alternatives_rejected: No broad ScreenHud token promotion, no repeated global D3DX Flush, no unowned projection, and no disabling normal native game fallback or GOAL/SkyGlow.

next_action: Validate exact record-bearing SHA with all four required GitHub Actions; repair only an observed source/CI failure under 01075, then separate C6; matching Quest3 HMD runtime remains UNTESTED.
